links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRE) of chatbot responses to dental prosthesis patient FAQs
links.effect: ChatGPT FKGL 10.45 ± 1.26 vs Gemini 7.82 ± 1.19 and Copilot 8.38 ± 1.59 (P<.001); ChatGPT FRE 53.05 ± 7.16 (fairly difficult), Gemini 64.94 ± 7.29 (plain English).
links.quote: Readability analysis showed ChatGPT (10.45 ± 1.26) produced significantly more complex responses compared to Gemini (7.82 ± 1.19) and Copilot (8.38 ± 1.59) (P <.001).

links.outcome: Reading grade level of chatbot patient-education responses
links.effect: ChatGPT responses averaged FKGL 10.45 and were rated fairly difficult (FRE 53.05); Gemini FKGL 7.82, Copilot 8.38.
links.quote: FRE scores indicated that ChatGPT's responses were categorized as fairly difficult (53.05 ± 7.16), while Gemini's responses were in plain English (64.94 ± 7.29), with a significant difference between them (P <.001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the response quality and readability of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot) when responding to frequently asked questions about dental prostheses, evaluated by experts.
